inventory.item: Cash flow statement has three buckets: operating, investing, financing; opening + net = closing
Indirect method: PBT, add back non-cash, move finance cost/interest income out, working capital, tax paid
Direct vs indirect allowed; Ramu and TCPL use indirect
Working capital changes: assets up uses cash, liabilities up provides cash (-8,-7,+5=-10)
Ind AS 7: interest paid and dividends paid financing; interest/dividends received investing (non-financial entities)
Capex found from balance sheets: 190+42-12=220, CWIP +3, total 45
Why profit != cash: depreciation +12, working capital -10, capex -45, borrowing +10, dividend -18 = PAT 50 to -1
Three statements connect: PAT->reserves, capex->fixed assets, WC<->current items, net cash = BS cash; 47=47
Indian dividend timing: FY25 dividend paid in FY26, FY26 in FY27; Ind AS 10 no liability at year end
Lab 1: sell on credit, profit up, cash not
Lab 2: event tracer (credit sale, machine with loan, dividend, depreciation) with balance and cash tie-out checks
TCPL consolidated CFO 2,421.85, CFI -1,398.17, CFF -1,075.39, net -51.71, closing 1,412.79
TCPL FCF/EBITDA 107% defined before capex and tax; reproduces ~106% from cash generated from operations; 70% after capex
TCPL cash flow cash is net of bank overdraft; FX line
Deferred: FCF/CFO quality (Part 13), accounting choices (Part 6), working-capital days (Part 12), banks (Part 29)
